codes.subject: invocation

params.name: reason
params.meaning: Why the argument is refused: unknown_name (no limit has that name), malformed_value (the value is not a non-negative whole number with a unit the limit allows), or above_default (the value is higher than the limit's default, and a limit is never raised).

params.name: name
params.meaning: The limit's name, present when the argument names a limit.

params.name: default
params.meaning: The limit's default, present when the argument names a limit.

params.name: unit
params.meaning: The limit's unit, present when the argument names a limit: bytes, count or ratio.

params.name: value
params.meaning: The value asked for, in the limit's unit, present when the reason is above_default and the value is at most 2^53.

codes.message: A --limit argument is refused ({reason}); a limit can only be lowered, to a whole number no higher than its default.
codes.hint: Run `metais limits` to see every limit's name, unit and default, and give --limit NAME=VALUE with VALUE at most that default.

codes.subject: report

params.name: listed
params.meaning: How many findings the report lists before this one.

params.name: omitted
params.meaning: How many more findings were found and not listed.

codes.message: The report lists the first {listed} findings; {omitted} more were found and are counted in the summary but not listed.
codes.hint: Fix the findings listed and run the command again, or read the summary's totals by code.
